name: Blanc on your computer
for: People who already use Blanc on a Mac or PC: blanc.day's iPhone links, the desktop app's Connect your iPhone, What's New pages, the newsletter and r/blancbrowser.
promotionalText: Use Blanc on your Mac or PC? Scan the code in its Settings → Sync, and your computer’s tabs, the pages it sends and the Spaces you share are on your iPhone too.

shots.title: Pair with your computer
shots.h: Pair with Blanc on your computer
shots.p: Scan the code in its Settings → Sync, then open your computer’s tabs and the pages it sends.

shots.title: Shared Spaces
shots.h: Share a Space with your computer
shots.p: Choose the Spaces to share. Open, close or move a tab on one device, and the other follows.

shots.title: Start Page
shots.p: Blanc for iPhone keeps your address and tabs in one bar at the bottom of the screen: the Island.

shots.title: Slash commands
shots.p: Type / for commands like /private and /history, or type anything to search your tabs, Favorites and History.

shots.title: Tab grid
shots.h: Every tab at a glance, in named groups
shots.p: See your tabs as cards, and keep the ones that belong together in a group, like Museum day.

shots.title: Private tabs
shots.p: And ads and trackers are blocked by default, in private tabs too.

name: Spaces and groups
for: People who keep a lot of tabs and want them sorted: blanc.day's Spaces and Arc alternative pages, and posts about organizing tabs.
promotionalText: Give each part of your day a Space, like Work or Trip. Keep tabs that belong together in named groups, and share a Space to keep it the same on your computer.

shots.title: Spaces
shots.h: A Space for each part of your day
shots.p: Keep Work and Trip tabs apart, and switch between them from the Island.

shots.title: Tab grid
shots.h: Tabs that belong together, in a group
shots.p: Name a group, like Museum day, and see every tab as a card.

shots.title: Your computer's tabs
shots.h: Your computer’s tabs, on your iPhone
shots.p: Pair with Blanc on your Mac or PC to open its tabs here and get the pages it sends you.

shots.title: Slash commands
shots.p: Type / for commands like /private and /history, or type anything to search your tabs, Favorites and History.

shots.title: Start Page
shots.p: Blanc for iPhone keeps your address and tabs in one bar at the bottom of the screen: the Island.

shots.title: Private tabs
shots.p: And ads and trackers are blocked by default, in private tabs too.

name: Private browsing
for: People looking for a private browser: blanc.day's private tabs and privacy pages, and privacy-minded communities.
promotionalText: Private tabs keep no history, and their cookies and site data go when the last one closes. Ads and trackers are blocked by default, and Sync is end-to-end encrypted.

shots.title: Private tabs
shots.p: Their cookies and site data go when you close the last one.

shots.title: Start Page
shots.p: Blanc for iPhone keeps your address and tabs in one bar at the bottom of the screen: the Island.

shots.title: Slash commands
shots.h: A private tab is a /private away
shots.p: Type it in the Island, or type anything to search your tabs, Favorites and History.

shots.title: Tab grid
shots.h: Every tab at a glance, in named groups
shots.p: See your tabs as cards, and keep the ones that belong together in a group, like Museum day.

shots.title: Spaces
shots.h: A Space for each part of your day
shots.p: Keep Work and Trip tabs apart, and share a Space to keep it the same on your computer.

shots.title: Your computer's tabs
shots.p: Pair with Blanc on your Mac or PC. Sync is end-to-end encrypted, so Blanc stores only data it can’t read.
